name: Mount Mogan's cozy little home
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Mount Mogan's cozy little home?
address: Houhong (Beside the Villagers Committee), Nanlu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 房間很漂亮，用的都是山泉水，有户外游泳池還有親子活動，確實是小驚喜！晚安糖水是紅豆湯哦！一定要去喝幾碗，喝過最好喝的糖水啦！推薦推薦！來莫干山一定要打卡這家民宿！下次試試竹取亭，日式私湯哦！
comments.author: Anonymous User
comments.quoteEn: Beautiful rooms, spring water throughout, an outdoor pool and things laid on for children. A real surprise. The bedtime sweet soup is red bean, and you must have several bowls of it, the best I have had. Anyone coming to Moganshan should stay here. Next time I want to try the Japanese style private bath.

comments.quote: 房間就比較像別人的家裡房間， 衞生：一般 設施：一般 環境：一般 服務：還不錯
comments.author: Au💖Yan ⁰⁴⁵²⁶⁶⁵⁹²⁶

comments.quote: 去的時候就已經猜到，經營者可能是比較年長的人，（因為之前住過的民宿，管家都是提早一天聯繫好，發旅遊小貼士的，交代一些住宿相關事宜的）叔叔阿姨，和藹可親，但是作為民宿而已，衞生、服務方面期待能提高一個檔次
